children: South Korea’s annual inflation rate slowed to 2.9% in September 2026 from 3.1% in August, in line with market expectations but remained above the central bank’s 2% target.
The slowdown was largely driven by softer price growth for food and non-alcoholic beverages (1.0% vs 1.3% in August), and alcohol and tobacco (0.1% vs 0.2%).
Inflation also moderated for health (1.6% vs 1.9%), education (1.6% vs 1.7%), and restaurants and hotels (2.8% vs 2.9%).

On the other hand, prices accelerated for housing, water, electricity and fuel (1.9% vs 1.5%), household goods and services (3.0% vs 2.9%), and transport (7.7% vs 6.3%), while inflation remained unchanged for clothing and footwear inflation at 2.8%.
Meanwhile, core inflation, excluding food and energy, eased to 2.8% from 3.4% in August, matching forecasts.
On a monthly basis, consumer prices rose 0.3%, marking the fastest rise since May and accelerating from 0.2% in August,

title: South Korea Inflation Rate Slows in September
